title: It's Thyme | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set in the peaceful coastal community of Seagrove Beach along scenic 30A, this expansive retreat offers a perfect blend of relaxation, entertainment, and coastal charm just steps from the beach. Sun-filled interiors create an airy and welcoming atmosphere, with beautifully designed living spaces that invite gatherings with family and friends. The chef’s kitchen features high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and generous seating, flowing effortlessly into the dining and living areas for memorable meals and conversations. Step outside to a private pool deck complete with a tranquil water feature, summer kitchen, and grilling station—ideal for relaxed afternoons and sunset dinners in the warm Gulf breeze. Entertainment and comfort extend across multiple levels, including a media and game room with shuffleboard, arcade games, and a wet bar for lively evenings indoors. Several balconies and a stunning rooftop terrace offer sweeping views toward the Gulf, creating peaceful spots to unwind with morning coffee or evening cocktails. With easy beach access just across 30A and thoughtful extras like a golf cart, bikes, and an elevator for convenience, this beautifully designed coastal getaway delivers the perfect setting for unforgettable beachside vacations.
